description: MetaBlooms OS tool routing policy. Routes work to the strongest available tool. Forbids weak or wrong-domain tools per domain.

routes.description: Work that reads truth from mounted OS artifacts at /mnt/data or Metablooms_OS. Direct filesystem, Python, and archive reads are authoritative. file_search is forbidden: it produces incomplete or stale results on mounted paths and bypasses the direct-read audit trail.
routes.rationale: file_search returns incomplete, potentially stale, or semantically wrong results for mounted OS artifacts. Direct reads are auditable, deterministic, and produce evidence suitable for receipts.

routes.description: Semantic search over user-uploaded documents (not mounted OS paths). file_search is permitted only when the target is a user upload and no mounted-OS-path string is present.
routes.rationale: Semantic search is the appropriate tool for uploaded document queries when mounted OS paths are not involved.

routes.description: Reading or writing GitHub repository content.
routes.rationale: GitHub repo content must be read through git or the GitHub API for auditability and correct branch targeting.

global_rules.description: file_search must never be used as the evidence source for mounted OS artifact truth without explicit human re-authorization.
All tool path selections must be recorded in the stage receipt with a justification string.
